lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: follow a tray line, choose set courses, pay first, and find a seat
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: At a workers' canteen, follow the line, choose a first and second course, and pay at the register before sitting.
lessons.title: Follow the Canteen Line
lessons.objective: Follow the tray line, choose an entrée and main course, pay at the register, and find a free seat.
lessons.focus: Use prenez un plateau, une entrée, un plat, la caisse and une place libre to follow the sequence in a workers’ canteen.
lessons.scene: Maya joins a workers’ canteen line for a quick lunch before returning to work.

cards.en: Do we take a tray here?

cards.fr: Je prends la salade et le poulet.
cards.en: I will have the salad and the chicken.
Do we pay before sitting down?

cards.fr: Il reste une place libre près de la fenêtre.
cards.en: There is a free seat left near the window.

cards.fr: Je prends mes couverts avec le plateau.
cards.en: I take my cutlery with the tray.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. On prend un plateau ici ?
reader.en: Hello. Do we take a tray here?

reader.speaker: Worker
reader.fr: Oui. Prenez un plateau et vos couverts, puis suivez la file.
reader.en: Yes. Take a tray and your cutlery, then follow the line.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Quelle entrée est disponible aujourd’hui ?
reader.en: Which starter is available today?

reader.speaker: Worker
reader.fr: Une salade. Pour le plat, il y a du poulet ou des légumes.
reader.en: A salad. For the main course, there is chicken or vegetables.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je prends la salade et le poulet.
reader.en: I will have the salad and the chicken.

reader.speaker: Worker
reader.fr: Très bien. Passez à la caisse avant de vous asseoir.
reader.en: Very good. Go to the register before sitting down.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: La caisse est au bout de la file ?
reader.en: Is the register at the end of the line?

reader.speaker: Worker
reader.fr: Oui. Ensuite, il reste une place libre près de la fenêtre.
reader.en: Yes. Then there is a free seat left near the window.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Je paie d’abord, puis je cherche cette table.
reader.en: Thanks. I will pay first, then look for that table.

speaking.opening: Bonjour. On prend un plateau ici ?
speaking.goal: Follow the tray line, select the salad and chicken, confirm that payment comes before seating and find a free table.
speaking.closure: Merci. Je passe à la caisse, puis je m’assieds.
wordBank: Je prends la salade et le poulet.
Il reste une place libre près de la fenêtre.
Je prends mes couverts avec le plateau.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French word for a tray.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the word for a free seat.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the question about paying before sitting.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for the register.

write.cueEnglish: Write an order for salad and chicken.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The canteen workflow is a fictional scene, not a claim about all workers’ canteens. Review entrée/plat terminology for this setting.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: ask about children's portions, plain dishes, high chairs, and sharing an adult plate
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Your picky six-year-old will only eat plain pasta; ask the kitchen what they can prepare and how it will be priced.
lessons.title: Ask for a Plain Child’s Lunch
lessons.objective: Ask for a small portion of plain pasta, a high chair or shared adult plate, and the price of the child’s serving.
lessons.focus: Use une portion pour enfant, des pâtes nature, sans sauce, une chaise haute and partager mon plat to describe the child’s lunch directly.
lessons.scene: Maya arrives with a six-year-old who wants plain pasta and a younger child who needs a high chair.

cards.fr: Mon enfant ne veut que des pâtes nature.
cards.en: My child only wants plain pasta.

cards.fr: La cuisine peut préparer une petite portion ?
cards.en: Can the kitchen prepare a small serving?
Do you have a high chair?

cards.fr: Combien coûte la portion pour enfant ?
cards.en: How much is the child’s portion?

cards.fr: Sans sauce ni fromage, s’il vous plaît.
Je prendrai la petite portion de pâtes.
cards.en: I will take the small pasta serving.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Vous avez une chaise haute pour mon plus jeune enfant ?
reader.en: Hello. Do you have a high chair for my younger child?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, je vous en apporte une. Qu’est-ce que votre enfant de six ans voudrait manger ?
reader.en: Yes, I will bring you one. What would your six-year-old like to eat?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Il ne veut que des pâtes nature, sans sauce ni fromage.
reader.en: He only wants plain pasta, without sauce or cheese.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Je peux demander à la cuisine une petite portion.
reader.en: I can ask the kitchen for a small serving.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Combien coûte la portion pour enfant ?
reader.en: Thank you. How much is the child’s portion?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Sept euros ici. Sinon, il peut partager votre plat.
reader.en: Seven euros here. Otherwise, he can share your dish.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je prendrai la petite portion de pâtes pour lui.
reader.en: I will take the small pasta serving for him.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Très bien. Je vous apporte aussi une petite assiette.
reader.en: Very good. I will bring you a small plate.

speaking.opening: Bonjour. Vous avez une chaise haute pour mon plus jeune enfant ?
speaking.goal: Ask for a high chair for the younger child and plain pasta without sauce or cheese for the six-year-old, check the child’s price and compare sharing your own dish.
speaking.closure: Merci. Je prends la petite portion pour lui.
wordBank: Mon enfant ne veut que des pâtes nature.
La cuisine peut préparer une petite portion ?
Combien coûte la portion pour enfant ?
Sans sauce ni fromage, s’il vous plaît.
Je prendrai la petite portion de pâtes.

see.cueEnglish: Find the phrase for plain pasta.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to ask for a high chair.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the child’s portion price question.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for a small plate.

say.cueEnglish: Ask whether the kitchen can make a small serving.

write.cueEnglish: Write a request for pasta without sauce or cheese.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The children’s preferences, kitchen offering and seven-euro price are fictional. Review age-specific chair language and pronoun clarity.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: ask about step-free entry, restrooms, quiet tables, and space for mobility aids
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Call a lunch spot to ask whether it has step-free access and a table that fits a wheelchair.
lessons.title: Call Ahead About Access
lessons.objective: Call a lunch spot to ask about step-free entry, wheelchair space, accessible restrooms and a quiet table.
lessons.focus: Use sans marche, fauteuil roulant, assez de place, toilettes accessibles and une table au calme to ask precise access questions.
lessons.scene: Maya phones a restaurant before lunch for a companion who uses a wheelchair.

cards.fr: Il y a assez de place pour un fauteuil roulant ?
cards.en: Is there enough space for a wheelchair?

cards.fr: Les toilettes sont accessibles en fauteuil roulant ?
Vous avez une table au calme pour deux ?
cards.en: Do you have a quiet table for two?

cards.fr: Le passage jusqu’à la table est assez large ?
cards.en: Is the route to the table wide enough?

cards.fr: Je voudrais réserver cette table pour midi.
cards.en: I would like to reserve that table for noon.

cards.fr: Merci de confirmer l’entrée et les toilettes.
cards.en: Thank you for confirming the entrance and restroom.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Je voudrais venir déjeuner avec une personne en fauteuil roulant.
reader.en: Hello. I would like to come for lunch with someone who uses a wheelchair.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Bonjour. Que voulez-vous savoir ?
reader.en: Hello. What would you like to know?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: L’entrée est sans marche ?
reader.en: Is the entrance step-free?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Oui, il y a une rampe à l’entrée.
reader.en: Yes, there is a ramp at the entrance.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le passage jusqu’à la table est assez large pour un fauteuil roulant ?
reader.en: Is the route to the table wide enough for a wheelchair?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Oui. Je peux vous réserver une table avec de la place autour.
reader.en: Yes. I can reserve a table with space around it.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Les toilettes sont accessibles en fauteuil roulant ?
reader.en: Is the restroom wheelchair-accessible?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Oui, les toilettes sont accessibles en fauteuil roulant et se trouvent au même niveau. Nous avons aussi une table au calme.
reader.en: Yes, the restroom is wheelchair-accessible and on the same level. We also have a quiet table.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Je voudrais réserver cette table pour midi.
reader.en: Thank you. I would like to reserve that table for noon.

speaking.opening: Bonjour. Je voudrais venir déjeuner avec une personne en fauteuil roulant.
speaking.goal: Confirm step-free entry, sufficient space through the room and at the table, restroom access and a quiet reservation at noon.
wordBank: Il y a assez de place pour un fauteuil roulant ?
Les toilettes sont accessibles en fauteuil roulant ?
Vous avez une table au calme pour deux ?
Le passage jusqu’à la table est assez large ?
Je voudrais réserver cette table pour midi.
Merci de confirmer l’entrée et les toilettes.

see.cueEnglish: Find the phrase for a step-free entrance.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to ask about wheelchair space.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the restroom access question.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for a ramp.

say.cueEnglish: Ask whether the route to the table is wide enough.

write.cueEnglish: Write a reservation request for the quiet table at noon.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Access statements are fictional scene facts. Qualified accessibility review should assess precision of sans marche, route width and restroom terminology; keep these notes outside teaching text.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: explain severity, ask about shared fryers, stocks, and sauces, and decide whether to eat elsewhere
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Explain that your partner reacts severely to shellfish, ask about the fryer and stock, and politely decide whether to stay.
lessons.title: Ask Directly About a Severe Shellfish Allergy
lessons.objective: State a severe shellfish allergy, ask about the fryer, broth and sauce, then decide whether to eat elsewhere.
lessons.focus: Use allergie grave, coquillages et crustacés, la même friteuse, le bouillon and contient to name the ingredient and preparation questions directly.
lessons.scene: At a market lunch stall, Maya asks about shellfish for a companion who reacts severely and chooses another place after the vendor answers.

cards.fr: Mon partenaire est gravement allergique aux coquillages et aux crustacés.
cards.en: My partner is severely allergic to mollusks and crustaceans.

cards.fr: Vous utilisez la même friteuse pour les crevettes ?
cards.en: Do you use the same fryer for shrimp?
We will eat elsewhere, thank you.

cards.fr: Merci de m’avoir expliqué la préparation.
cards.en: Thank you for explaining the preparation.

cards.fr: Il réagit gravement aux coquillages et aux crustacés.
cards.en: He has a severe reaction to mollusks and crustaceans.

cards.fr: La sauce contient aussi des crevettes séchées.
cards.en: The sauce also contains dried shrimp.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Mon partenaire est gravement allergique aux coquillages et aux crustacés.
reader.en: Hello. My partner is severely allergic to mollusks and crustaceans.

reader.speaker: Vendor
reader.fr: D’accord. Qu’aimeriez-vous savoir ?
reader.en: All right. What would you like to know?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Vous utilisez la même friteuse pour les crevettes et les frites ?
reader.en: Do you use the same fryer for shrimp and fries?

reader.speaker: Vendor
reader.fr: Oui, nous utilisons la même huile.
reader.en: Yes, we use the same oil.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le bouillon ou la sauce contiennent des crustacés ?
reader.en: Does the stock or sauce contain crustaceans?

reader.speaker: Vendor
reader.fr: Le bouillon contient des crevettes, et la sauce contient aussi des crevettes séchées.
reader.en: The stock contains shrimp, and the sauce also contains dried shrimp.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci de m’avoir expliqué la préparation et l’utilisation de la même huile. Nous allons manger ailleurs.
reader.en: Thank you for explaining the preparation and use of the same oil. We will eat elsewhere.

reader.speaker: Vendor
reader.fr: Je comprends. Bonne journée à vous deux.
reader.en: I understand. Have a good day, both of you.

speaking.role: Lunch guest speaking for a companion
speaking.opening: Bonjour. Mon partenaire est gravement allergique aux coquillages et aux crustacés.
speaking.goal: Name the severe shellfish allergy, ask whether shrimp shares the fryer and whether the broth or sauce contains shellfish, then politely decide to eat elsewhere.
speaking.closure: Merci pour vos réponses. Nous allons manger ailleurs.
wordBank: Mon partenaire est gravement allergique aux coquillages et aux crustacés.
Vous utilisez la même friteuse pour les crevettes ?
Merci de m’avoir expliqué la préparation.
Il réagit gravement aux coquillages et aux crustacés.
La sauce contient aussi des crevettes séchées.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for a severe allergy.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the French word for a fryer.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the question about shrimp in the fryer.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for crustaceans.

say.cueEnglish: Ask whether the stock contains crustaceans.

write.cueEnglish: Write a polite decision to eat elsewhere.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Qualified French and food-domain review should confirm exact shellfish scope, fryer/stock terminology and scenario facts. Preserve direct clinical vocabulary; do not add learner-facing cautions.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Dispute a cover or service charge
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: question an unexpected cover, bread, or service charge and agree on a resolution
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Your bill includes bread you declined and a service charge not on the menu; question it calmly and settle the total.
lessons.title: Question an Unexpected Bill Charge
lessons.objective: Identify bread and service charges on a bill, explain that the bread was declined, ask where the service charge was listed, and settle a corrected total.
lessons.focus: Use des frais de couvert, des frais de service, je n’ai pas pris, c’était indiqué and corriger l’addition to question each charge precisely.
lessons.scene: At the end of lunch, Maya notices bread and service charges she did not expect and asks the server to explain them.

cards.fr: Je n’ai pas pris de pain.
cards.en: I did not take any bread.

cards.fr: Pourquoi le pain figure-t-il sur l’addition ?
cards.en: Why is bread listed on the bill?

cards.fr: Les frais de service étaient indiqués sur la carte ?
cards.en: Was the service charge listed on the menu?
Can you explain this line item?

cards.fr: Pouvez-vous retirer le pain et corriger l’addition ?
cards.en: Can you remove the bread and correct the bill?
All right, I will pay this total.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Excusez-moi. Pouvez-vous m’expliquer ces deux lignes sur l’addition ?
reader.en: Excuse me. Can you explain these two line items on the bill?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Ce sont des frais de couvert pour le pain et des frais de service.
reader.en: They are a cover charge for bread and a service charge.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je n’ai pas pris de pain ; je l’ai refusé au début du repas.
reader.en: I did not take any bread; I declined it at the start of the meal.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Je vais vérifier et retirer cette ligne.
reader.en: I will check and remove that line item.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Les frais de service étaient indiqués sur la carte ?
reader.en: Thank you. Was the service charge listed on the menu?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Non, elle ne les indique pas. Je vais aussi retirer ces frais.
reader.en: No, it does not list them. I will remove those charges too.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Quel est le total corrigé ?
reader.en: What is the corrected total?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Vingt-quatre euros, sans le pain ni les frais de service.
reader.en: Twenty-four euros, without the bread or the service charge.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: D’accord, je règle ce total. Merci pour la correction.
reader.en: All right, I will pay this total. Thank you for the correction.

speaking.opening: Excusez-moi. Pouvez-vous m’expliquer ces deux lignes sur l’addition ?
speaking.goal: Question both charges, state that bread was declined, ask where service was listed, confirm the corrected total and pay it.
speaking.closure: D’accord. Je règle le total corrigé.
wordBank: Je n’ai pas pris de pain.
Pourquoi le pain figure-t-il sur l’addition ?
Les frais de service étaient indiqués sur la carte ?
Pouvez-vous retirer le pain et corriger l’addition ?

see.cueEnglish: Find the term for a service charge.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to say the bread was not taken.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the question about the menu listing.

type.cueEnglish: Type the expression for the corrected total.

say.cueEnglish: Ask the server to explain one bill line.

write.cueEnglish: Write a request to remove the bread and correct the bill.
